purpose: Zero-model adjudication of same-fact compact read efficiency.
historical_fact_rule: H is the non-empty cell/address/value/formula content visibly recoverable from the archived observation; capped output uses only the visible prefix/head-tail.
hindsight_rule: Only explicit historical requests or finite ranges/predicates mechanically present before the observation are admissible; visible addresses are never used as query filters.

primary_gate.fact_preservation: >=4/6 tasks with >=95% fact match on candidate-comparable facts and no systematic wrong facts
primary_gate.query_realizability: >=4/6 tasks with >=75% eligible observations directly/mechanically realizable
primary_gate.payload_materiality: >=4/6 tasks with median >=25% reduction versus actual historical visible observation bytes
primary_gate.freshness: zero stale responses, silent truncations, or systematic fidelity failures

live_phase_rule: Run no live phase unless the repaired mechanical gate passes; this replay failed the query-realizability and raw-payload-materiality components.
